text: Start a workout with a few minutes of light movement and easy versions of the first exercises, then build up.
Rest days are part of training. Muscles recover between sessions, so easy days or full rest help progress.
Increase reps, sets or weight gradually, a little at a time, and keep form clean before making things harder.
Protein is easier to fit in when it is spread over the day's meals and snacks instead of saved for one.
Drink water through the day and around workouts, more when it is hot or the session is long.
